comment: botl.c hilite_reset_needed() compares a temporary highlight's timer with gb.bl_hilite_moves, which status_eval_next_unhilite() sets once per hero action. Dropping gold under gold/down starts a 3-turn highlight; the plate mail's dressing delay ends in moveloop's once-per-turn block, after svm.moves has advanced, and unmul()'s message forces a --More-- whose bot() must still show the highlight.
